basic_profile.bio: A 25-year-old graphic designer from Austin, Texas, just diving into the Reddit universe. I'm a huge fan of sci-fi and have been obsessed with cyberpunk aesthetics ever since I watched Blade Runner as a kid. I enjoy gaming in my free time, especially RPGs and anything with a strong narrative. Recently, I've been trying to learn more about sustainable fashion, which is why you'll see me lurking in some unexpected subreddits. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work or during my morning coffee. Single but enjoying the freedom it brings, I love exploring new hobbies and meeting like-minded people online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge predominantly revolves around graphic design and digital art. I've got a bachelor's degree in Fine Arts and have been working in the design industry for over three years. I also have a growing interest in game design, particularly how visual storytelling can enhance player experience. Most of my insights come from self-study, online courses, and engaging with communities on platforms like Reddit.
